title: Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (32 mins) | 🎙️ My late-2026 How I AI bench: GPT-6.2 disappointed me, Opus 5.5 is my least annoying daily driver, and Gemini 4 Neon is now my top pick
summary: We’re back in model release season, and I put the newest frontier models through my How I AI bench: 25 tasks across coding, writing, creative, video, prototyping, and personal-assistant work, with six models scored blind. I compare GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Neon and Carbon.
takeaways: I compare GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Neon and Carbon.
I also walk through the SVG, animation, storybook, and prototype tests side by side and share a new eval I built from my own session data: the Claire Annoyance Bench.
The dark-horse winner surprised me—and it wasn’t close.
